      d$tokens$start_line <- as.integer(findInterval(d$tokens$start_offset, starts))
      d$tokens$end_line <- as.integer(findInterval(d$tokens$end_offset, starts))
      d$tokens$start_column <- as.integer(d$tokens$start_offset - starts[d$tokens$start_line] + 1L)
      d$tokens$end_column <- as.integer(d$tokens$end_offset - starts[d$tokens$end_line] + 1L)
    }
    d
  })
  units$code_status <- vapply(details, function(d) d$status, character(1))
  units$token_count <- vapply(details, function(d) d$token_count, integer(1))
  units$details <- I(details)
  units
}

compare_code_pair <- function(doc_a, doc_b, max_pairs = 10000L, max_pair_chars = 5000000L) {
  max_pairs <- code_positive_integer(max_pairs, "max_pairs")
  max_pair_chars <- code_positive_integer(max_pair_chars, "max_pair_chars")
  a <- prepare_code_units(doc_a); b <- prepare_code_units(doc_b)
  na <- nrow(a); nb <- nrow(b)
  if (as.double(na) * nb > max_pairs) stop("Code pair limit exceeded.")
  if (sum(nchar(a$content)) * as.double(nb) + sum(nchar(b$content)) * as.double(na) > max_pair_chars)
    stop("Code pair character work limit exceeded.")
  matches <- data.frame(file_id_a = character(), file_id_b = character(), unit_id_a = character(),
    unit_id_b = character(), raw_equal = logical(), tokens_equal = logical(), renamed_equal = logical(),
    token_count = integer(), start_line_a = integer(), end_line_a = integer(),
    start_line_b = integer(), end_line_b = integer(), status = character(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  matches$variable_map <- I(list())
  comments <- data.frame(unit_id_a = character(), unit_id_b = character(), comment_count = integer(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  for (i in seq_len(na)) for (j in seq_len(nb)) {
    x <- a$details[[i]]; y <- b$details[[j]]
    cx <- x$tokens$text[x$tokens$kind == "COMMENT"]; cy <- y$tokens$text[y$tokens$kind == "COMMENT"]
    if (length(cx) && identical(cx, cy)) comments <- rbind(comments,
      data.frame(unit_id_a = a$unit_id[i], unit_id_b = b$unit_id[j], comment_count = length(cx)))
    raw <- x$status != "empty" && y$status != "empty" && nzchar(trimws(a$content[i])) && identical(a$content[i], b$content[j])
    lexical <- x$parse_status == "ok" && y$parse_status == "ok" && x$token_count > 0L && y$token_count > 0L &&
      identical(x$normalized_key, y$normalized_key)
    renamed <- x$rename_status == "ok" && y$rename_status == "ok" &&
      identical(x$renamed_key, y$renamed_key)
    if (!raw && !lexical && !renamed) next
    row <- data.frame(file_id_a = a$file_id[i], file_id_b = b$file_id[j], unit_id_a = a$unit_id[i], unit_id_b = b$unit_id[j],
      raw_equal = raw, tokens_equal = lexical, renamed_equal = renamed,
      token_count = as.integer(min(x$token_count, y$token_count)), start_line_a = a$start_line[i], end_line_a = a$end_line[i],
      start_line_b = b$start_line[j], end_line_b = b$end_line[j],
      status = if (x$status == "ok" && y$status == "ok") "ok" else "limited", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    row$variable_map <- I(list(if (renamed) data.frame(a = x$variable_map$name, b = y$variable_map$name)
      else data.frame(a = character(), b = character())))
    matches <- rbind(matches, row)
  }
  limited <- any(c(a$code_status, b$code_status) == "limited") ||
    any(c(doc_a$diagnostics$severity, doc_b$diagnostics$severity) %in% c("warning", "error"))
  status <- if (limited) "limited" else if (!na || !nb) "not_applicable" else
    if (any(c(a$code_status, b$code_status) == "empty")) "insufficient_content" else "ok"
  list(status = status, matches = matches, comment_matches = comments, code_a = a, code_b = b,
    parameters = list(max_pairs = max_pairs, max_pair_chars = max_pair_chars),
    diagnostics = list(a = doc_a$diagnostics, b = doc_b$diagnostics))
}
# END R/code.R

# BEGIN R/code-local.R
# Requires parser.R and code.R; all submitted code remains unevaluated.
.code_nonnegative_integer <- function(x, name) {
  if (!is.numeric(x) || length(x) != 1L || is.na(x) || !is.finite(x) ||
      x < 0 || x != floor(x) || x > .Machine$integer.max)
    stop(paste(name, "must be a representable nonnegative integer."))
  as.integer(x)
}

.code_statements_from_units <- function(units, max_statements) {
  result <- data.frame(file_id = character(), unit_id = character(), statement_id = character(),
    statement_index = integer(), content = character(), token_count = integer(),
    normalized_key = character(), shape_key = character(), unit_status = character(),
    start_line = integer(), end_line = integer(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  result$tokens <- I(list()); result$rename_eligible <- I(list())
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(units))) {
    d <- units$details[[i]]
    if (d$parse_status != "ok" || !identical(d$statement_status, "ok")) next
    if (nrow(result) + length(d$statements) > max_statements) stop("Total code statement limit exceeded.")
    for (j in seq_along(d$statements)) {
      s <- d$statements[[j]]; tokens <- d$tokens[s$token_rows, , drop = FALSE]
      row <- data.frame(file_id = units$file_id[i], unit_id = units$unit_id[i],
        statement_id = paste0(units$unit_id[i], ":e", sprintf("%04d", j)), statement_index = as.integer(j),
        content = s$content, token_count = as.integer(nrow(tokens)), normalized_key = s$normalized_key,
        shape_key = s$shape_key, unit_status = d$status, start_line = tokens$start_line[1L],
        end_line = tail(tokens$end_line, 1L), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
      row$tokens <- I(list(tokens)); row$rename_eligible <- I(list(s$rename_eligible))
      result <- rbind(result, row)
    }
  }
  rownames(result) <- NULL
  result
}

prepare_code_statements <- function(doc, max_statements = 2000L) {
  max_statements <- code_positive_integer(max_statements, "max_statements")
  .code_statements_from_units(prepare_code_units(doc), max_statements)
}

make_code_windows <- function(statements, window_tokens = 100L, window_statements = 20L, max_windows = 500L) {
  window_tokens <- code_positive_integer(window_tokens, "window_tokens")
  window_statements <- code_positive_integer(window_statements, "window_statements")
  max_windows <- code_positive_integer(max_windows, "max_windows")
  if (window_statements > 20L) stop("window_statements must not exceed 20.")
  if (!is.data.frame(statements) || !all(c("unit_id", "statement_id", "token_count") %in% names(statements)))
    stop("statements must come from prepare_code_statements.")
  result <- data.frame(window_id = character(), unit_id = character(), token_count = integer(), oversize = logical())
  result$statement_indices <- I(list())
  for (unit in unique(statements$unit_id)) {
    indices <- which(statements$unit_id == unit); start <- 1L; n <- length(indices)
    while (start <= n) {
      end <- start; total <- statements$token_count[indices[start]]
      while (end < n && end - start + 1L < window_statements &&
          total + statements$token_count[indices[end + 1L]] <= window_tokens) {
        end <- end + 1L; total <- total + statements$token_count[indices[end]]
      }
      if (nrow(result) >= max_windows) stop("Code window limit exceeded.")
      row <- data.frame(window_id = paste0("w", sprintf("%05d", nrow(result) + 1L)),
        unit_id = unit, token_count = as.integer(total), oversize = total > window_tokens)
      row$statement_indices <- I(list(indices[seq.int(start, end)]))
      result <- rbind(result, row)
      if (end == n) break
      start <- start + max(1L, as.integer(floor((end - start + 1L) / 2)))
    }
  }
  result
}

.code_window_features <- function(statements, windows) {
  rows <- list()
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(windows))) for (mode in c("lexical", "renamed")) {
    indices <- windows$statement_indices[[i]]
    keys <- statements[[if (mode == "lexical") "normalized_key" else "shape_key"]][indices]
    keys <- unique(keys[!is.na(keys)])
    if (length(keys)) rows[[length(rows) + 1L]] <- data.frame(window_index = i, mode = mode, key = keys)
  }
  if (!length(rows)) return(data.frame(window_index = integer(), mode = character(), key = character()))
  do.call(rbind, rows)
}

select_code_candidates <- function(statements_a, statements_b, windows_a, windows_b,
    max_candidates = 500L, max_seed_pairs = 100000L) {
  max_candidates <- code_positive_integer(max_candidates, "max_candidates")
  max_seed_pairs <- code_positive_integer(max_seed_pairs, "max_seed_pairs")
  a <- .code_window_features(statements_a, windows_a); b <- .code_window_features(statements_b, windows_b)
  empty <- data.frame(window_index_a = integer(), window_index_b = integer(), mode = character())
  if (!nrow(a) || !nrow(b)) return(empty)
  ca <- table(paste(a$mode, a$key, sep = "\002")); cb <- table(paste(b$mode, b$key, sep = "\002"))
  common <- intersect(names(ca), names(cb))
  projected <- sum(as.double(ca[common]) * as.double(cb[common]))
  if (projected > max_seed_pairs) stop("Code seed-pair limit exceeded.")
  joined <- merge(a, b, by = c("mode", "key"), suffixes = c("_a", "_b"), sort = FALSE)
  if (!nrow(joined)) return(empty)
  result <- unique(joined[, names(empty), drop = FALSE])
  if (nrow(result) > max_candidates) stop("Code candidate limit exceeded.")
  result <- result[order(result$window_index_a, result$window_index_b, result$mode), , drop = FALSE]
  rownames(result) <- NULL
  result
}

.extend_code_mapping <- function(a, b, mode, mapping) {
  if (mode == "lexical") return(if (identical(a$normalized_key, b$normalized_key)) mapping else NULL)
  if (is.na(a$shape_key) || is.na(b$shape_key) || !identical(a$shape_key, b$shape_key)) return(NULL)
  ta <- a$tokens[[1L]]; tb <- b$tokens[[1L]]
  eligible <- a$rename_eligible[[1L]]
  for (k in which(eligible)) {
    x <- ta$text[k]; y <- tb$text[k]; existing <- match(x, mapping$a)
    if (!is.na(existing)) {
      if (mapping$b[existing] != y) return(NULL)
    } else {
      if (y %in% mapping$b) return(NULL)
      mapping <- rbind(mapping, data.frame(a = x, b = y, stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
    }
  }
  mapping
}

.code_local_matches <- function(a, b, wa, wb, candidates, min_tokens, min_statements,
    max_skips, max_states, max_results, max_token_work) {
  states <- 0; work <- 0; paths <- list(); seen <- new.env(parent = emptyenv())
  empty_map <- data.frame(a = character(), b = character(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  for (ci in seq_len(nrow(candidates))) {
    ia <- wa$statement_indices[[candidates$window_index_a[ci]]]
    ib <- wb$statement_indices[[candidates$window_index_b[ci]]]
    mode <- candidates$mode[ci]
    attempt <- function(i, j, mapping) {
      states <<- states + 1; work <<- work + max(a$token_count[ia[i]], b$token_count[ib[j]])
      if (states > max_states) stop("Code local search state limit exceeded.")
      if (work > max_token_work) stop("Code local token work limit exceeded.")
      .extend_code_mapping(a[ia[i], , drop = FALSE], b[ib[j], , drop = FALSE], mode, mapping)
    }
    walk <- function(pa, pb, mapping, skipped) {
      i <- tail(pa, 1L); j <- tail(pb, 1L); extended <- FALSE
      if (i < length(ia) && j < length(ib)) {
        remaining <- max_skips - skipped
        for (di in seq_len(min(as.double(remaining) + 1, length(ia) - i)))
          for (dj in seq_len(min(as.double(remaining) - di + 2, length(ib) - j))) {
            next_map <- attempt(i + di, j + dj, mapping)
            if (is.null(next_map)) next
            extended <- TRUE
            walk(c(pa, i + di), c(pb, j + dj), next_map, skipped + di + dj - 2L)
          }
      }
      aa <- ia[pa]; bb <- ib[pb]
      count <- sum(a$token_count[aa])
      if (extended || length(aa) < min_statements || count < min_tokens) return(invisible(NULL))
      if (mode == "renamed" && all(a$normalized_key[aa] == b$normalized_key[bb])) return(invisible(NULL))
      keys <- paste(a$statement_id[aa], b$statement_id[bb], sep = "=")
      key <- paste(mode, paste(keys, collapse = "/"), sep = ":")
      if (exists(key, envir = seen, inherits = FALSE)) return(invisible(NULL))
      if (length(paths) >= max_results) stop("Code local result limit exceeded.")
      assign(key, TRUE, envir = seen)
      paths[[length(paths) + 1L]] <<- list(a = aa, b = bb, mapping = mapping, mode = mode, keys = keys)
    }
    for (i in seq_along(ia)) for (j in seq_along(ib)) {
      mapping <- attempt(i, j, empty_map)
      if (!is.null(mapping)) walk(i, j, mapping, 0L)
    }
  }
  keep <- vapply(seq_along(paths), function(i) !any(vapply(seq_along(paths), function(j)
    paths[[i]]$mode == paths[[j]]$mode && length(paths[[j]]$a) > length(paths[[i]]$a) &&
      all(paths[[i]]$keys %in% paths[[j]]$keys), logical(1))), logical(1))
  paths <- paths[keep]
  matches <- data.frame(file_id_a = character(), file_id_b = character(), unit_id_a = character(), unit_id_b = character(),
    method = character(), matched_statements = integer(), matched_tokens = integer(), skipped_statements = integer(),
    skipped_tokens = integer(), alignment_ratio = numeric(), start_line_a = integer(), end_line_a = integer(),
    start_line_b = integer(), end_line_b = integer(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  list_cols <- c("statement_pairs", "variable_map", "token_starts_a", "token_ends_a", "token_starts_b", "token_ends_b",
    "skipped_statements_a", "skipped_statements_b")
  for (name in list_cols) matches[[name]] <- I(list())
  for (path in paths) {
    aa <- path$a; bb <- path$b
    skipped_a <- setdiff(seq.int(aa[1L], tail(aa, 1L)), aa)
    skipped_b <- setdiff(seq.int(bb[1L], tail(bb, 1L)), bb)
    skipped_tokens <- sum(a$token_count[skipped_a]) + sum(b$token_count[skipped_b])
    total <- sum(a$token_count[aa])
    row <- data.frame(file_id_a = a$file_id[aa[1L]], file_id_b = b$file_id[bb[1L]],
      unit_id_a = a$unit_id[aa[1L]], unit_id_b = b$unit_id[bb[1L]], method = path$mode,
      matched_statements = as.integer(length(aa)), matched_tokens = as.integer(total),
      skipped_statements = as.integer(length(skipped_a) + length(skipped_b)), skipped_tokens = as.integer(skipped_tokens),
      alignment_ratio = total / (total + skipped_tokens), start_line_a = a$start_line[aa[1L]],
      end_line_a = a$end_line[tail(aa, 1L)], start_line_b = b$start_line[bb[1L]], end_line_b = b$end_line[tail(bb, 1L)])
    row$statement_pairs <- I(list(data.frame(statement_id_a = a$statement_id[aa], statement_id_b = b$statement_id[bb],
      content_a = a$content[aa], content_b = b$content[bb], start_line_a = a$start_line[aa], end_line_a = a$end_line[aa],
      start_line_b = b$start_line[bb], end_line_b = b$end_line[bb], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)))
    row$variable_map <- I(list(path$mapping))
    for (side in c("a", "b")) for (edge in c("start", "end")) {
      table <- if (side == "a") a else b; indices <- if (side == "a") aa else bb
      positions <- as.integer(unlist(lapply(table$tokens[indices], function(t) t[[paste0(edge, "_offset")]]), use.names = FALSE))
      row[[paste0("token_", edge, "s_", side)]] <- I(list(positions))
    }
    row$skipped_statements_a <- I(list(a$statement_id[skipped_a]))
    row$skipped_statements_b <- I(list(b$statement_id[skipped_b]))
    matches <- rbind(matches, row[, names(matches), drop = FALSE])
  }
  if (nrow(matches)) {
    matches <- matches[order(-matches$matched_tokens, matches$skipped_tokens, matches$start_line_a, matches$start_line_b, matches$method), , drop = FALSE]
    rownames(matches) <- NULL
  }
  list(matches = matches, state_count = states, token_work = work)
}

.code_local_coverage <- function(doc, units, matches, side, lexical_only) {
  comparable <- as.integer(unlist(lapply(units$details, function(d) {
    if (d$parse_status != "ok") return(integer())
    d$tokens$start_offset[d$tokens$kind != "COMMENT" & d$tokens$text != ";"]
  }), use.names = FALSE))
  comparable <- unique(comparable)
  rows <- if (lexical_only) matches$method == "lexical" else rep(TRUE, nrow(matches))
  matched <- unique(as.integer(unlist(matches[[paste0("token_starts_", side)]][rows], use.names = FALSE)))
  if (!all(matched %in% comparable)) stop("Code coverage contains unknown token positions.")
  data.frame(side = toupper(side), file_id = doc$file_id, comparable_tokens = length(comparable),
    matched_tokens = length(matched), coverage = if (length(comparable)) length(matched) / length(comparable) else NA_real_,
    status = if (length(comparable)) "ok" else "insufficient_tokens", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}

analyze_code_pair_local <- function(doc_a, doc_b, window_tokens = 100L, window_statements = 20L,
    min_tokens = 20L, min_statements = 1L, max_skips = 1L, max_statements = 2000L,
    max_windows = 500L, max_candidates = 500L, max_seed_pairs = 100000L,
    max_states = 50000L, max_results = 1000L, max_token_work = 5000000L) {
  config <- list(window_tokens = window_tokens, window_statements = window_statements, min_tokens = min_tokens,
    min_statements = min_statements, max_statements = max_statements, max_windows = max_windows,
    max_candidates = max_candidates, max_seed_pairs = max_seed_pairs, max_states = max_states,
    max_results = max_results, max_token_work = max_token_work)
  config <- Map(code_positive_integer, config, names(config))
  max_skips <- .code_nonnegative_integer(max_skips, "max_skips"); config$max_skips <- max_skips
  if (config$window_statements > 20L || config$min_statements > config$window_statements)
    stop("Require min_statements <= window_statements <= 20.")
  ua <- prepare_code_units(doc_a); ub <- prepare_code_units(doc_b)
  a <- .code_statements_from_units(ua, config$max_statements)
  b <- .code_statements_from_units(ub, config$max_statements)
  wa <- make_code_windows(a, config$window_tokens, config$window_statements, config$max_windows)
  wb <- make_code_windows(b, config$window_tokens, config$window_statements, config$max_windows)
  candidates <- select_code_candidates(a, b, wa, wb, config$max_candidates, config$max_seed_pairs)
  local <- .code_local_matches(a, b, wa, wb, candidates, config$min_tokens, config$min_statements,
    config$max_skips, config$max_states, config$max_results, config$max_token_work)
  coverage <- rbind(.code_local_coverage(doc_a, ua, local$matches, "a", FALSE), .code_local_coverage(doc_b, ub, local$matches, "b", FALSE))
  lexical <- rbind(.code_local_coverage(doc_a, ua, local$matches, "a", TRUE), .code_local_coverage(doc_b, ub, local$matches, "b", TRUE))
  limited <- any(c(ua$code_status, ub$code_status) == "limited") ||
    any(c(doc_a$diagnostics$severity, doc_b$diagnostics$severity) %in% c("warning", "error"))
  status <- if (limited) "limited" else if (!nrow(ua) || !nrow(ub)) "not_applicable" else
    if (!nrow(a) || !nrow(b)) "insufficient_content" else "ok"
  list(status = status, matches = local$matches, coverage = coverage, lexical_coverage = lexical,
    code_a = ua, code_b = ub, statements_a = a, statements_b = b, windows_a = wa, windows_b = wb,
    candidates = candidates, state_count = local$state_count, token_work = local$token_work, parameters = config,
    diagnostics = list(a = doc_a$diagnostics, b = doc_b$diagnostics))
}
# END R/code-local.R

# BEGIN R/report.R
# Evidence report integration. Submitted Rmd files are read only by read_rmd().
report_escape <- function(x) {
  x <- enc2utf8(as.character(x)); x[is.na(x)] <- "不适用"
  for (pair in list(c("&", "&amp;"), c("<", "&lt;"), c(">", "&gt;"),
      c("\"", "&quot;"), c("'", "&#39;"), c("`", "&#96;")))
    x <- gsub(pair[1L], pair[2L], x, fixed = TRUE)
  x
}

.report_module <- function(fun) {
  warnings <- character()
  value <- tryCatch(withCallingHandlers(fun(), warning = function(w) {
    warnings <<- c(warnings, conditionMessage(w)); invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
  }), error = identity)
  if (inherits(value, "error")) return(list(status = "error", error = conditionMessage(value), warnings = warnings, value = NULL))
  list(status = if (length(warnings) && value$status == "ok") "limited" else value$status,
    error = "", warnings = unique(warnings), value = value)
}

analyze_rmd_pair <- function(input_a, input_b, text_options = list(), formula_options = list(), code_options = list()) {
  for (options in list(text_options, formula_options, code_options)) {
    if (!is.list(options) || (length(options) && (is.null(names(options)) || any(!nzchar(names(options))) || anyDuplicated(names(options)))))
      stop("Module options must be named lists with unique names.")
  }
  if (any(c("doc_a", "doc_b") %in% c(names(text_options), names(formula_options), names(code_options))))
    stop("Input documents cannot be overridden through module options.")
  inputs <- list(A = input_a, B = input_b)
  docs <- lapply(names(inputs), function(id) tryCatch(read_rmd(inputs[[id]], file_id = id), error = identity))
  names(docs) <- names(inputs)
  manifest <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(inputs), function(id) {
    d <- docs[[id]]; ok <- inherits(d, "rmd_document"); path <- inputs[[id]]
    data.frame(file_id = id, filename = if (is.character(path) && length(path) == 1L && !is.na(path)) basename(path) else "无效路径",
      read_status = if (ok) "ok" else "error", characters = if (ok) d$summary$characters else NA_integer_,
      units = if (ok) nrow(d$units) else NA_integer_, diagnostics = if (ok) nrow(d$diagnostics) else NA_integer_,
      message = if (ok) "" else conditionMessage(d), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }))
  skip <- function() list(status = "not_run", error = "两份输入均成功读取后才运行分析。", warnings = character(), value = NULL)
  modules <- setNames(lapply(seq_len(5L), function(i) skip()), c("text", "formula_single", "formula_sequence", "code_whole", "code_local"))
  if (all(manifest$read_status == "ok")) {
    args <- list(doc_a = docs$A, doc_b = docs$B)
    modules$text <- .report_module(function() do.call(analyze_text_pair_approx, c(args, text_options)))
    modules$formula_single <- .report_module(function() do.call(compare_math_pair, args))
    modules$formula_sequence <- .report_module(function() do.call(find_math_sequences, c(args, formula_options)))
    modules$code_whole <- .report_module(function() do.call(compare_code_pair, args))
    modules$code_local <- .report_module(function() do.call(analyze_code_pair_local, c(args, code_options)))
  }
  statuses <- vapply(modules, function(m) m$status, character(1))
  overall <- if (any(manifest$read_status == "error")) "input_error" else if (any(statuses == "error")) "partial_failure" else
    if (any(statuses == "limited")) "limited" else "completed"
  list(engine_version = "0.6.0-dev", verdict = "not_enabled", overall_status = overall,
    manifest = manifest, documents = docs, modules = modules,
    requested_options = list(text = text_options, formula_sequence = formula_options, code_local = code_options),
    r_version = as.character(getRversion()))
}

.report_table <- function(df) {
  if (!is.data.frame(df) || !nrow(df)) return("<p class='muted'>没有对应条目。</p>")
  rows <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(df)), function(i) paste0("<tr>", paste0("<td>", report_escape(vapply(df, function(col)
    if (is.na(col[i])) "不适用" else as.character(col[i]), character(1))), "</td>", collapse = ""), "</tr>"), character(1))
  paste0("<div class='table-wrap'><table><thead><tr>", paste0("<th>", report_escape(names(df)), "</th>", collapse = ""),
    "</tr></thead><tbody>", paste0(rows, collapse = ""), "</tbody></table></div>")
}
.report_pre <- function(text, max_chars = 4000L) {
  text <- paste0(text, collapse = "\n")
  clipped <- nchar(text, type = "chars") > max_chars
  paste0("<pre><code>", report_escape(substr(text, 1L, max_chars)), "</code></pre>",
    if (clipped) "<p class='muted'>展示已截断至4000字符；分析仍使用完整片段。</p>" else "")
}
.report_pair <- function(a, b, label_a = "A", label_b = "B") paste0("<div class='evidence-pair'><div><h4>",
  report_escape(label_a), "</h4>", .report_pre(a), "</div><div><h4>", report_escape(label_b), "</h4>", .report_pre(b), "</div></div>")
.report_source <- function(doc, positions) {
  positions <- positions[!is.na(positions)]
  if (!length(positions)) "" else substring(doc$source, min(positions), max(positions))
}
.report_params <- function(x, prefix = "") {
  if (!length(x)) return(data.frame(parameter = character(), value = character()))
  rows <- lapply(names(x), function(name) {
    key <- if (nzchar(prefix)) paste(prefix, name, sep = ".") else name
    if (is.list(x[[name]])) .report_params(x[[name]], key) else
      data.frame(parameter = key, value = paste(as.character(x[[name]]), collapse = ", "), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  })
  do.call(rbind, rows)
}

detector_report_html <- function(result, max_evidence = 10L) {
  max_evidence <- code_positive_integer(max_evidence, "max_evidence")
  if (max_evidence > 100L) stop("max_evidence must not exceed 100.")
  if (!is.list(result) || !identical(result$verdict, "not_enabled")) stop("Expected an analyze_rmd_pair result.")
  out <- character(); add <- function(...) out <<- c(out, paste0(...))
  section <- function(title) add("<h2>", report_escape(title), "</h2>")
  note <- function(text) add("<p>", report_escape(text), "</p>")
  module <- function(name) {
    m <- result$modules[[name]]
    note(paste("分析状态：", m$status))
    if (nzchar(m$error)) add("<div class='notice error'>", .report_pre(m$error), "</div>")
    if (length(m$warnings)) add(.report_pre(paste(m$warnings, collapse = "\n")))
    m$value
  }
  evidence_rows <- function(df, title, fun) {
    add("<h3>", report_escape(title), "</h3>")
    if (!nrow(df)) { note("没有达到当前规则的对应条目；这不是无抄袭结论。"); return(invisible(NULL)) }
    n <- min(nrow(df), max_evidence)
    note(paste0("共 ", nrow(df), " 条，展示前 ", n, " 条；可重叠，不作为独立证据累计。"))
    for (i in seq_len(n)) {
      add("<article class='evidence'><h4>", report_escape(paste(title, i)), "</h4>")
      fun(df[i, , drop = FALSE]); add("</article>")
    }
  }
  line_pair <- function(row, a, b) .report_pair(a, b,
    paste0("A：第", row$start_line_a, "—", row$end_line_a, "行"),
    paste0("B：第", row$start_line_b, "—", row$end_line_b, "行"))
  add("<div class='detector-report'>")
  add("<div class='notice'><strong>未启用最终判定</strong><p>本报告提供相似片段及定位，不能证明抄袭、复制方向或数学/程序语义等价。参数尚未标定，不输出抄袭概率，也不平均三类指标。</p></div>")
  note(paste("运行状态：", result$overall_status, "；引擎：", result$engine_version, "；R：", result$r_version))
  section("输入与分析概况"); add(.report_table(result$manifest))
  labels <- c(text = "文字", formula_single = "完整公式", formula_sequence = "公式步骤", code_whole = "完整代码", code_local = "局部代码")
  statuses <- data.frame(module = unname(labels), status = vapply(result$modules, function(m) m$status, character(1)), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  add(.report_table(statuses))
  note("error 表示模块未完成，不能按零相似度处理；limited 表示只分析了支持的范围。not_applicable、insufficient等状态需结合原文核查。")
  if (any(result$manifest$read_status != "ok")) {
    note("输入读取失败，本次未运行分项比较。请检查路径、Rmd扩展名及UTF-8编码后重新运行。")
    add("</div>"); return(paste(out, collapse = "\n"))
  }
  da <- result$documents$A; db <- result$documents$B
  section("文字：字符覆盖与片段"); text <- module("text")
  if (!is.null(text)) {
    note(paste("字符片段 Jaccard：", if (is.na(text$jaccard$similarity)) "信息不足" else format(text$jaccard$similarity, digits = 5)))
    note("以下覆盖按实际相同源字符的并集计算；替换字符、插删空位和忽略的排版标记不计覆盖。行号区间不等于整段均匹配。")
    add(.report_table(text$coverage))
    evidence_rows(text$exact_matches, "精确文字片段", function(row) {
      add(.report_table(row[, c("matched_chars", "start_line_a", "end_line_a", "start_line_b", "end_line_b"), drop = FALSE]))
      add(line_pair(row, .report_source(da, row$source_positions_a[[1L]]), .report_source(db, row$source_positions_b[[1L]])))
    })
    evidence_rows(text$approximate_matches, "近似文字片段", function(row) {
      add(.report_table(row[, c("equal_chars", "alignment_columns", "similarity"), drop = FALSE]))
      add(line_pair(row, .report_source(da, row$aligned_positions_a[[1L]]), .report_source(db, row$aligned_positions_b[[1L]])))
    })
    note("精确和近似表可能展示同一处内容；上述覆盖已经去重。近似算法受种子、窗口及每窗口一个最佳对齐限制。")
  }
  section("公式：完整表达与多步对应"); single <- module("formula_single")
  if (!is.null(single)) evidence_rows(single$matches, "完整公式对应", function(row) {
    add(.report_table(row[, c("raw_equal", "normalized_equal", "renamed_equal", "token_count", "status"), drop = FALSE]))
    a <- single$formulas_a$content[match(row$unit_id_a, single$formulas_a$unit_id)]
    b <- single$formulas_b$content[match(row$unit_id_b, single$formulas_b$unit_id)]
    add(line_pair(row, a, b)); add(.report_table(row$variable_map[[1L]]))
  })
  sequence <- module("formula_sequence")
  if (!is.null(sequence)) evidence_rows(sequence$matches, "推导步骤对应", function(row) {
    add(.report_table(row[, c("matched_steps", "skipped_steps", "step_similarity", "token_count"), drop = FALSE]))
    add(.report_table(row$variable_map[[1L]]))
    pairs <- row$step_pairs[[1L]]
    for (j in seq_len(nrow(pairs))) add(line_pair(pairs[j, , drop = FALSE], pairs$content_a[j], pairs$content_b[j]))
    for (side in c("a", "b")) {
      ids <- row[[paste0("skipped_units_", side)]][[1L]]
      if (length(ids)) { table <- sequence[[paste0("formulas_", side)]]
        note(paste(toupper(side), "跳过且未计匹配的步骤：")); add(.report_pre(table$content[match(ids, table$unit_id)])) }
    }
  })
  note("公式以转义后的LaTeX源码展示，不加载在线排版资源。短标准公式不单独构成抄袭结论；未计算公式覆盖率。完整公式接口与步骤接口的支持范围不同。")
  section("代码：词法与一致改名"); whole <- module("code_whole")
  if (!is.null(whole)) {
    evidence_rows(whole$matches, "完整代码单元对应", function(row) {
      add(.report_table(row[, c("raw_equal", "tokens_equal", "renamed_equal", "token_count", "status"), drop = FALSE]))
      add(line_pair(row, whole$code_a$content[match(row$unit_id_a, whole$code_a$unit_id)], whole$code_b$content[match(row$unit_id_b, whole$code_b$unit_id)]))
      add(.report_table(row$variable_map[[1L]]))
    })
    add("<h3>注释补充对应</h3>", .report_table(utils::head(whole$comment_matches, max_evidence)))
    note(paste("注释补充共", nrow(whole$comment_matches), "条；仅显示前", max_evidence, "条，不作为独立主要证据。"))
  }
  local <- module("code_local")
  if (!is.null(local)) {
    add("<h3>原词法 token 覆盖</h3>", .report_table(local$lexical_coverage))
    add("<h3>包含一致改名的对应 token 覆盖</h3>", .report_table(local$coverage))
    note("第二种覆盖允许变量字符不同，统计结构对应token；不是文字相同字符覆盖，不能与字符数或公式步骤数相加。")
    evidence_rows(local$matches, "局部代码对应", function(row) {
      add(.report_table(row[, c("method", "matched_statements", "matched_tokens", "skipped_statements", "skipped_tokens", "alignment_ratio"), drop = FALSE]))
      add(.report_table(row$variable_map[[1L]])); pairs <- row$statement_pairs[[1L]]
      for (j in seq_len(nrow(pairs))) add(line_pair(pairs[j, , drop = FALSE], pairs$content_a[j], pairs$content_b[j]))
      for (side in c("a", "b")) {
        ids <- row[[paste0("skipped_statements_", side)]][[1L]]
        if (length(ids)) { table <- local[[paste0("statements_", side)]]
          note(paste(toupper(side), "跳过且未计覆盖的语句：")); add(.report_pre(table$content[match(ids, table$statement_id)])) }
      }
    })
    note("只按顶层完整语句匹配，不进入函数/循环内部查找局部片段。完整单元与局部表可能重叠；覆盖按源token位置去重。")
  }
  section("解析诊断与未覆盖内容")
  for (id in c("A", "B")) { add("<h3>", id, " 的解析诊断</h3>", .report_table(utils::head(result$documents[[id]]$diagnostics, 100L))) }
  for (name in c("formula_single", "formula_sequence", "code_whole", "code_local")) {
    value <- result$modules[[name]]$value
    if (is.null(value)) next
    for (side in c("a", "b")) {
      units <- value[[paste0(if (startsWith(name, "formula")) "formulas_" else "code_", side)]]
      rows <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(units)), function(i) {
        issues <- units$details[[i]]$issues
        if (!length(issues)) return(NULL)
        data.frame(side = toupper(side), unit_id = units$unit_id[i], line = units$start_line[i], issue = paste(issues, collapse = "; "))
      })
      rows <- Filter(Negate(is.null), rows)
      if (length(rows)) { note(paste(labels[[name]], toupper(side), "的受限诊断共", length(rows), "条：")); add(.report_table(utils::head(do.call(rbind, rows), 100L))) }
    }
  }
  note("诊断表最多展示100条。图片内容、外部资源、复杂语法和未成功解析区域不视为已分析；共同题干和标准解法尚未排除。")
  section("本次参数与方法边界")
  add(.report_table(.report_params(result$requested_options)))
  for (name in names(result$modules)) {
    value <- result$modules[[name]]$value
    if (is.null(value)) next
    parameters <- value$parameters
    if (is.null(parameters) && name == "formula_single") parameters <- list(max_pairs = value$max_pairs)
    if (length(parameters)) { add("<h3>", report_escape(labels[[name]]), "</h3>", .report_table(.report_params(parameters))) }
  }
  note(paste("每类最多展示", max_evidence, "条；展示截断不改变分析或覆盖结果。参数只是当前开发默认值，尚未作检测能力标定。"))
  note("本版本尚未实现最终判断规则、公共题干排除、公式覆盖及开发/保留集效果评估。高覆盖可能来自共同来源或标准解法；低覆盖可能来自语法限制或改写。请结合原文核查。")
  add("</div>")
  paste(out, collapse = "\n")
}
# END R/report.R

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, error = FALSE)

report_result <- analyze_rmd_pair(
  params$input_a, params$input_b,
  text_options = list(k = params$text_k, min_chars = params$text_min_chars,
    min_similarity = params$text_min_similarity),
  formula_options = list(min_steps = params$formula_min_steps,
    max_steps = params$formula_max_steps, max_skips = params$formula_max_skips),
  code_options = list(min_tokens = params$code_min_tokens,
    window_tokens = params$code_window_tokens, max_skips = params$code_max_skips)
)
cat(detector_report_html(report_result, params$max_evidence))
